CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.chatbot_ncdc_offices
TABLESPACE pg_default
AS SELECT o.id,
    o.ncdcid,
    o.office_type,
    o.name_of_office,
    o.phone_number,
    o.email,
    o.full_address,
    o.pin_code,
    o.controller_name,
    o.controller_designation,
    o.controller_email,
    o.controller_phone_number,
    o.area_sq_ft,
    o.type AS geometry_type,
    COALESCE(obt.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS ownership_type_name,
    o.specialization,
    o.latitude,
    o.longitude,
    o.status,
    o.created_by,
    o.approved_by,
    o.approved_at,
    o.created_at,
    o.updated_at,
    o.is_approved,
    COALESCE(ot.type_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS office_type_name,
    COALESCE(dg.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS controller_designation_name,
    COALESCE(s.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS state_name,
    COALESCE(dt.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS district_name
   FROM ncdc_offices o
     LEFT JOIN ncdc_office_type ot ON o.office_type = ot.id
     LEFT JOIN designations dg ON o.controller_designation = dg.id
     LEFT JOIN states s ON o.state_ut = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts dt ON o.district = dt.district_code
     LEFT JOIN office_building_types obt ON o.ownership = obt.id
WITH DATA;

-- View indexes:
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_active_partial ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (state_name, district_name) WHERE (status = 1);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_approved_partial ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (state_name, district_name) WHERE (is_approved = 1);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_created_at ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (created_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_id ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_ncdcid ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (ncdcid);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_office_type ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (office_type);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_pin_code ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (pin_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_state_district ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (state_name, district_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_ncdc_offices_status ON public.chatbot_ncdc_offices USING btree (status);
description: The materialized view chatbot_ncdc_offices provides a structured dataset of NCDC office details where each row represents an office entity identified by `id` and `ncdcid`, including core attributes such as `office_type`, `office_type_name`, and `name_of_office`, along with contact information like `phone_number`, `email`, `full_address`, and `pin_code`; it captures administrative and managerial details including `controller_name`, `controller_designation`, `controller_designation_name`, `controller_email`, and `controller_phone_number`; geographic and location-related attributes include `state_name`, `district_name`, and spatial coordinates (`latitude`, `longitude`), along with `geometry_type` describing the spatial representation of the office; infrastructure-related information includes `area_sq_ft` and `ownership_type_name`, while `specialization` provides context about office functions or expertise; system-level metadata such as `status`, `created_by`, `approved_by`, `approved_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, and `is_approved` indicate record lifecycle and governance; the view is optimized with indexes to support efficient querying by office identifiers, geography, office type, pin code, approval status, and timestamps, enabling fast filtering and retrieval—this view is designed for analytical querying and LLM usage where the model needs to understand office locations, administrative structure, contact details, and operational characteristics of NCDC offices to generate meaningful insights or responses.

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.chatbot_national_federations
TABLESPACE pg_default
AS SELECT nf.id,
    nf.cooperative_id,
    nf.reference_year,
    nf.cooperative_society_name,
    nf.identification_number,
    nf.registration_number,
    nf.date_registration,
        CASE nf.location_of_head_quarter
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Urban'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Rural'::text
            ELSE 'N/A'::text
        END AS location_of_head_quarter,
    COALESCE(ag.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS affiliation_with_govt_dept_name,
    COALESCE(ulb.localbody_type_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS urban_local_body_type_name,
    COALESCE(ulb.local_body_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS urban_local_body_name,
    COALESCE(ulbw.ward_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS ward_name,
    COALESCE(b.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS block_name,
    COALESCE(gp.gram_panchayat_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS gram_panchayat_name,
    COALESCE(v.village_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS village_name,
    nf.pincode,
    nf.registred_office_address AS registered_office_address,
    COALESCE(dg.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS designation_name,
    nf.functional_status,
    nf.designation_other,
    nf.total_number_of_members,
    COALESCE(nfcd_agg.phone_numbers, 'N/A'::text) AS phone_number,
    COALESCE(nfcd_agg.emails, 'N/A'::text) AS email,
    COALESCE(nfcd_agg.contact_persons, 'N/A'::text) AS contact_person,
    nf.user_id,
    nf.is_draft,
    nf.is_new,
    nf.created_by,
    nf.updated_by,
    nf.created,
    nf.updated,
    nf.ncd_id,
    COALESCE(s.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS state_name,
    COALESCE(dt.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS district_name,
    COALESCE(ma_agg.major_activities_names, 'N/A'::text) AS major_activities_names
   FROM national_federations nf
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT national_federations_contact_details.national_federations_id,
            string_agg(DISTINCT national_federations_contact_details.phone_number::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (national_federations_contact_details.phone_number::text)) AS phone_numbers,
            string_agg(DISTINCT national_federations_contact_details.email::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (national_federations_contact_details.email::text)) AS emails,
            string_agg(DISTINCT national_federations_contact_details.contact_person::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (national_federations_contact_details.contact_person::text)) AS contact_persons
           FROM national_federations_contact_details
          WHERE national_federations_contact_details.deleted_at IS NULL
          GROUP BY national_federations_contact_details.national_federations_id) nfcd_agg ON nf.id = nfcd_agg.national_federations_id
     LEFT JOIN states s ON nf.state_code = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts dt ON nf.district_code = dt.district_code
     LEFT JOIN affiliation_with_govt_dept ag ON nf.affiliation_with_govt_dept = ag.id
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_bodies ulb ON nf.urban_local_body_code = ulb.localbody_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_bodies_wards ulbw ON nf.locality_ward_code = ulbw.ward_code
     LEFT JOIN blocks b ON nf.block_code = b.block_code
     LEFT JOIN gram_panchayats gp ON nf.gram_panchayat_code = gp.gram_panchayat_code
     LEFT JOIN villages v ON nf.village_code = v.village_code
     LEFT JOIN designations dg ON nf.designation = dg.id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT nf_inner.id,
            string_agg(DISTINCT ma.name::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (ma.name::text)) AS major_activities_names
           FROM national_federations nf_inner
             LEFT JOIN major_activities ma ON POSITION((ma.id::text) IN (nf_inner.major_activities_id)) > 0
          GROUP BY nf_inner.id) ma_agg ON nf.id = ma_agg.id
WITH DATA;

-- View indexes:
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_active_partial ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (state_name, district_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_cooperative_id ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (cooperative_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_created ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (created);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_functional_status ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (functional_status);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_id ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_new_partial ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (state_name, district_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_pincode ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (pincode);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_reference_year ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (reference_year);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_nf_state_district ON public.chatbot_national_federations USING btree (state_name, district_name);
description: The materialized view chatbot_national_federations provides a comprehensive and enriched dataset of national-level cooperative federations where each row represents a federation identified by `id`, `cooperative_id`, and `cooperative_society_name`, including identification and registration details such as `identification_number`, `registration_number`, `reference_year`, and `date_registration`, along with classification of headquarters location through `location_of_head_quarter` (Urban/Rural); it captures detailed geographic hierarchy through `state_name`, `district_name`, `block_name`, `gram_panchayat_name`, `village_name`, `urban_local_body_type_name`, `urban_local_body_name`, and `ward_name`, along with address details like `pincode` and `registered_office_address`; administrative and organizational attributes include `designation_name`, `designation_other`, `functional_status`, `affiliation_with_govt_dept_name`, and `total_number_of_members`; it aggregates contact-related information such as `phone_number`, `email`, and `contact_person` into readable comma-separated values, and also aggregates `major_activities_names` to provide a consolidated view of federation activities; additional metadata fields like `user_id`, `is_draft`, `is_new`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `created`, `updated`, and `ncd_id` indicate record lifecycle, ownership, and governance; the view is optimized with indexes to support efficient querying by geography, cooperative identifiers, reference year, functional status, pincode, and timestamps—this view is designed for analytical querying and LLM usage where the model needs to understand national federation profiles, filter by location, administrative attributes, and activities, and generate meaningful insights from structured federation data.

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings
TABLESPACE pg_default
AS SELECT crs.id,
    crs.main_id,
    crs.cooperative_id,
    crs.cooperative_name,
    crs.full_address,
    crs.date_registration,
    COALESCE(s.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS state_name,
    COALESCE(dt.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS district_name,
    COALESCE(b.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS block_name,
    COALESCE(ulb.local_body_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS urban_local_body_name,
        CASE crs.location_of_head_quarter
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Urban'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Rural'::text
            ELSE 'N/A'::text
        END AS location_of_head_quarter,
    COALESCE(pa.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS sector_name,
    crs.total_score,
    crs.rank,
        CASE crs.rank_type
            WHEN 1 THEN 'State'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'District'::text
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Block (State Nodal)'::text
            WHEN 4 THEN 'District (District Nodal)'::text
            WHEN 5 THEN 'Block (District Nodal)'::text
            WHEN 6 THEN 'Admin'::text
            ELSE 'Unknown'::text
        END AS rank_type_name,
    crs.date_time,
    crs.created_by,
    crs.flag
   FROM coorperative_ranking_score crs
     LEFT JOIN states s ON crs.state_code = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts dt ON crs.district_code = dt.district_code
     LEFT JOIN blocks b ON crs.block_code = b.block_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_bodies ulb ON crs.urban_local_body_code = ulb.localbody_code
     LEFT JOIN primary_activities pa ON crs.sector_code = pa.id
WITH DATA;

-- View indexes:
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_cooperative_id ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (cooperative_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_date_time ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (date_time);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_id ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_main_id ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (main_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_rank ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (rank);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_sector ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (sector_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_state_district_block ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (state_name, district_name, block_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_coop_rank_total_score ON public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings USING btree (total_score);
description: The materialized view chatbot_cooperative_rankings provides a structured dataset of cooperative society rankings where each row represents a ranked cooperative identified by `id`, `main_id`, `cooperative_id`, and `cooperative_name`, including basic details such as `full_address` and `date_registration`, along with geographic hierarchy fields like `state_name`, `district_name`, `block_name`, and `urban_local_body_name`, and classification of location through `location_of_head_quarter` (Urban/Rural); it captures sectoral classification using `sector_name` and ranking metrics including `total_score` and `rank`, along with `rank_type_name` which defines the level or context of ranking (such as State, District, Block, or Admin level); additional metadata fields like `date_time`, `created_by`, and `flag` provide context about when and how the ranking was generated; the view is optimized with multiple indexes to support efficient querying, enabling fast filtering and sorting by cooperative identifiers, geographic hierarchy, sector, rank, score, and time—this view is designed for analytical querying and LLM usage where the model needs to compare, rank, and analyze cooperative societies based on performance metrics and generate meaningful insights across different administrative levels.

    eti.is_projector_available,

    eti.is_hostel_available,

    eti.is_transport_service,
    eti.no_vehicles,
    eti.carring_capacity,

   FROM education_training_institute eti

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.chatbot_state_district_federation
TABLESPACE pg_default
AS SELECT sdf.id,
    sdf.cooperative_federation_name,
    COALESCE(ra.authority_name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS registration_authority_name,
    sdf.date_registration,
    sdf.registration_number,
    COALESCE(aoo.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS area_of_operation_name,
        CASE sdf.sector_of_operation
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Credit'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Non Credit'::text
            ELSE 'N/A'::text
        END AS sector_of_operation_type_name,
    COALESCE(pa.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS sector_of_operation_name,
    sdf.functional_status,
    sdf.federation_type,
        CASE sdf.federation_type
            WHEN 2 THEN 'State Federation'::text
            WHEN 3 THEN 'District Federation'::text
            ELSE 'N/A'::text
        END AS federation_type_name,
    sdf.location_details_of_head_quarter,
        CASE sdf.location_of_head_quarter
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Urban'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Rural'::text
            ELSE 'N/A'::text
        END AS location_of_head_quarter,
    COALESCE(s.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS state_name,
    COALESCE(d.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS district_name,
    sdf.pincode,
    sdf.full_address,
    sdf.contact_person,
    COALESCE(des.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS designation_name,
    sdf.designation_other,
    sdf.mobile,
    sdf.landline,
    sdf.email,
    sdf.has_building,
    COALESCE(obt.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS building_type,
    sdf.members_of_federation,
    sdf.bank_type,
    sdf.federation_doing_business,
    sdf.federation_doing_marketing,
    sdf.marketed_product_value,
    sdf.is_federation_member,
    sdf.primary_cooperative_member_count,
    sdf.other_member,
    sdf.other_member_count,
    sdf.financial_audit,
    sdf.audit_complete_year,
    sdf.category_audit,
    COALESCE(ac.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS category_audit_name,
    sdf.is_profit_making,
    sdf.net_profit,
    sdf.net_loss,
    sdf.authorised_share,
    sdf.annual_turnover,
    sdf.is_dividend_paid,
    sdf.dividend_rate,
        CASE sdf.operation_area_location
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Urban'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Rural'::text
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Both'::text
            ELSE 'N/A'::text
        END AS operation_area_location,
    sdf.federation_code,
    sdf.cooperative_society_bank_id AS cooperative_society_bank_ids,
    ( SELECT string_agg(csb.bank_name::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (csb.bank_name::text)) AS string_agg
           FROM cooperative_society_banks csb
          WHERE csb.id::text = ANY (string_to_array(replace(NULLIF(NULLIF(sdf.cooperative_society_bank_id::text, ''::text), 'NULL'::text), ' '::text, ''::text), ','::text))) AS cooperative_society_bank_names,
    sdf.other_bank,
    sdf.is_draft,
    sdf.is_approved,
    sdf.status,
    sdf.ncd_id,
    sdf.created,
    sdf.updated
   FROM state_district_federations sdf
     LEFT JOIN registration_authorities ra ON sdf.registration_authority_id = ra.id
     LEFT JOIN area_of_operations aoo ON sdf.area_of_operation_id = aoo.id
     LEFT JOIN primary_activities pa ON sdf.primary_activity = pa.id
     LEFT JOIN states s ON sdf.state_code = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts d ON sdf.district_code = d.district_code
     LEFT JOIN designations des ON sdf.designation = des.id
     LEFT JOIN office_building_types obt ON sdf.building_type = obt.id
     LEFT JOIN audit_categories ac ON sdf.category_audit = ac.id
WITH DATA;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.chatbot_state_cooperative_banks
TABLESPACE pg_default
AS SELECT scb.id,
    scb.parent_id,
    scb.scb_name AS bank_name,
        CASE scb.scb_dcb_flag
            WHEN 1 THEN 'SCB'::text
            WHEN 2 THEN 'DCB'::text
            WHEN 3 THEN 'SCARDB'::text
            WHEN 4 THEN 'PCARDB'::text
            ELSE 'Unknown'::text
        END AS bank_level,
    scb.scb_registration_no,
    scb.registration_date,
    scb.rbi_license,
    scb.rbi_license_date,
    scb.ifsc_code,
    ra.authority_name AS registration_authority_name,
    scb.location_urban_rural,
    s.name AS state_name,
    d.name AS district_name,
    scb.operation_area_location,
    scb.is_city,
    scb.city_name,
    dbg.block_name,
    dbg.gram_panchayat_name,
    dbg.village_name,
    ulbt.localbody_type_name AS urban_local_body_category_name,
    ulb.local_body_name AS urban_local_body_name,
    ulbw.ward_name,
    scb.pin_code,
    scb.full_address,
    scb.functional_status,
    COALESCE(scb_cd_agg.phone_numbers, 'N/A'::text) AS contact_phones,
    COALESCE(scb_cd_agg.emails, 'N/A'::text) AS contact_emails,
    COALESCE(scb_cd_agg.contact_persons, 'N/A'::text) AS contact_persons,
    scb.number_of_member,
    scb.number_of_branches,
    ( SELECT string_agg(st.name::text, ', '::text) AS string_agg
           FROM states st
          WHERE st.state_code::text = ANY (string_to_array(scb.area_of_operation_state_code::text, ','::text))) AS area_of_operation_states,
    scb.latest_audit_year,
    scb.is_profit_making,
    scb.net_profit,
    scb.net_loss,
    scb.annual_turnover,
    scb.annual_income,
    scb.annual_expense,
    scb.is_dividend_paid,
    scb.dividend_paid_rate,
    scb.total_assets,
    scb.total_liabilities,
    obt.name AS office_building_type_name,
    scb.has_office_building,
    scb.is_scheme_implemented,
    tom.name AS dccb_bank_type_membership_name,
    scb.dccb_bank_member,
    scb.dccb_bank_member_count,
    scb.dccb_bank_is_member,
    scb.pacs_member,
    scb.pacs_member_class_membership,
    scb.pacs_member_count,
    ( SELECT string_agg(dist.name::text, ', '::text) AS string_agg
           FROM districts dist
          WHERE dist.district_code::text = ANY (string_to_array(scb.society_district_code, ','::text))) AS society_district_names,
    scb.pacs_is_member_affiliated,
    scb.pacs_is_member_not_affiliated,
    scb.other_member,
    scb.other_member_count,
    scb.member_details,
    scb.is_comp,
    scb.status,
    scb.is_delete,
    scb.is_draft,
    scb.created_at,
    scb.updated,
    scb.ncd_id
   FROM state_cooperative_banks scb
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scb_contact_details.state_cooperative_bank_id,
            string_agg(DISTINCT scb_contact_details.phone_number::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (scb_contact_details.phone_number::text)) FILTER (WHERE scb_contact_details.phone_number IS NOT NULL AND scb_contact_details.phone_number::text <> ''::text) AS phone_numbers,
            string_agg(DISTINCT scb_contact_details.email::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (scb_contact_details.email::text)) FILTER (WHERE scb_contact_details.email IS NOT NULL AND scb_contact_details.email::text <> ''::text) AS emails,
            string_agg(DISTINCT scb_contact_details.contact_person::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (scb_contact_details.contact_person::text)) FILTER (WHERE scb_contact_details.contact_person IS NOT NULL AND scb_contact_details.contact_person::text <> ''::text) AS contact_persons
           FROM scb_contact_details
          GROUP BY scb_contact_details.state_cooperative_bank_id) scb_cd_agg ON scb.id = scb_cd_agg.state_cooperative_bank_id
     LEFT JOIN registration_authorities ra ON scb.registration_authority = ra.id
     LEFT JOIN states s ON scb.state_code = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts d ON scb.district_code = d.district_code
     LEFT JOIN districts_blocks_gp_villages dbg ON scb.block_code = dbg.block_code AND scb.gp_code = dbg.gram_panchayat_code AND scb.village_code = dbg.village_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_body_types ulbt ON scb.urban_local_body_category_code = ulbt.localbody_type_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_bodies ulb ON scb.urban_local_body_code = ulb.localbody_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_bodies_wards ulbw ON scb.locality_ward_code = ulbw.ward_code
     LEFT JOIN office_building_types obt ON scb.office_building_type = obt.id
     LEFT JOIN type_of_memberships tom ON scb.dccb_bank_type_membership = tom.id
WITH DATA;

TABLESPACE pg_default

    ra.authority_name AS registration_authority,
    cr.is_multi_state,
    cr.functional_status,
    aoo.name AS area_of_operation,
    cr.water_body_type_id AS water_body_type,
    pa.name AS sector_of_operation_name,

    cr.pincode,
    cr.full_address,

    des.name AS designation,
    cr.designation_other,
    cr.mobile,
    cr.landline,
    cr.email,
    cr.is_affiliated_union_federation,
    cr.affiliated_union_federation_level,
    cr.affiliated_union_federation_name,
    cr.members_of_society,
    cr.financial_audit,
        CASE
            WHEN cr.cleaned_audit ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text AND cr.cleaned_audit::numeric <= 2147483647::numeric THEN cr.cleaned_audit::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS audit_complete_year,
    ac.name AS audit_category,
    cr.is_profit_making,
    cr.annual_profit,
    cr.an_turnover,
    cr.annual_loss,
    cr.is_dividend_paid,
    cr.dividend_rate,
    csb.bank_name,
    cr.bank_type,
    cr.pan_no,
    cr.gst_no,
    cr.how_many_branches,
    cr.full_time_secretary,
    cr.mobile_number_of_secretary,
    cr.is_coastal,
    cr.is_draft,
    cr.status,
    cr.is_approved,
    cr.id
   FROM ( SELECT cooperative_registrations.id,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_society_name,
            cooperative_registrations.local_langauge_society_name,
            cooperative_registrations.registration_authoritie_id,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_id_new,

            cooperative_registrations.registration_number,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_society_type_id,
            cooperative_registrations.is_multi_state,
            cooperative_registrations.area_of_operation_id,
            cooperative_registrations.water_body_type_id,

            cooperative_registrations.primary_activity,
            cooperative_registrations.sector_of_operation_other,
            cooperative_registrations.secondary_activity,
            cooperative_registrations.secondary_activity_other,

            cooperative_registrations.location_of_head_quarter,
            cooperative_registrations.state_code,
            cooperative_registrations.district_code,
            cooperative_registrations.block_code,
            cooperative_registrations.gram_panchayat_code,
            cooperative_registrations.is_coastal,
            cooperative_registrations.village_code,
            cooperative_registrations.urban_local_body_type_code,
            cooperative_registrations.urban_local_body_code,

            cooperative_registrations.contact_person,
            cooperative_registrations.designation,
            cooperative_registrations.designation_other,
            cooperative_registrations.mobile,
            cooperative_registrations.landline,

            cooperative_registrations.is_affiliated_union_federation,

            cooperative_registrations.members_of_society,
            cooperative_registrations.financial_audit,
            cooperative_registrations.audit_complete_year,
            cooperative_registrations.category_audit,
            cooperative_registrations.is_profit_making,
            cooperative_registrations.annual_profit,

            cooperative_registrations.approved_by,
            cooperative_registrations.status,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_id_num,
            cooperative_registrations.operational_district_code,
            cooperative_registrations.under_computerised_scheme,
            cooperative_registrations.bank_type,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_society_bank_id,
            cooperative_registrations.other_bank,
            cooperative_registrations.is_corrected,
            cooperative_registrations.is_from_api,
            cooperative_registrations.updated_correction_date,
            cooperative_registrations.is_correction,
            cooperative_registrations.is_disclaimer,
            cooperative_registrations.sr_no,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_id,
            cooperative_registrations.updation_checkbox,
            cooperative_registrations.updation_time,
            cooperative_registrations.update_membership_flag,

            cooperative_registrations.pacs_csc_updation,
            cooperative_registrations.del_date,
            cooperative_registrations.del_by,
            cooperative_registrations.ncd_generation,
            cooperative_registrations.msme_updation,
            cooperative_registrations.is_msme,
            cooperative_registrations.udyam_no,
            cooperative_registrations.step1,
            cooperative_registrations.step2,
            cooperative_registrations.step3,
            cooperative_registrations.step4,
            cooperative_registrations.deleted_at,
            cooperative_registrations.created_at,
            cooperative_registrations.updated_at,
            cooperative_registrations.ref_no,
            cooperative_registrations.step5,
            cooperative_registrations.step6,
            cooperative_registrations.step7,
            cooperative_registrations.step8,
            cooperative_registrations.cooperative_society_hindi_name,
            cooperative_registrations.address_line,
            cooperative_registrations.is_rcs_api,
            cooperative_registrations.is_new_from_api,
            cooperative_registrations.state_code_from_api,
            cooperative_registrations.financial_updated_by,
            cooperative_registrations.financial_updated_date,
            cooperative_registrations.is_financial_update,
            cooperative_registrations.deregistered,
            cooperative_registrations.date_deregistered,
            cooperative_registrations.api_date,
            replace(NULLIF(NULLIF(cooperative_registrations.audit_complete_year::text, ''::text), 'NULL'::text), ','::text, ''::text) AS cleaned_audit,
            replace(NULLIF(NULLIF(cooperative_registrations.water_body_type_id::text, ''::text), 'NULL'::text), ','::text, ''::text) AS cleaned_wbt,
            replace(NULLIF(NULLIF(cooperative_registrations.cooperative_society_bank_id, ''::text), 'NULL'::text), ','::text, ''::text) AS cleaned_bank
           FROM cooperative_registrations) cr
     LEFT JOIN registration_authorities ra ON cr.registration_authoritie_id = ra.id
     LEFT JOIN area_of_operations aoo ON cr.area_of_operation_id = aoo.id
     LEFT JOIN primary_activities pa ON cr.primary_activity = pa.id
     LEFT JOIN states s ON cr.state_code = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts d ON cr.district_code = d.district_code
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (districts_blocks_gp_villages.block_code, districts_blocks_gp_villages.gram_panchayat_code, districts_blocks_gp_villages.village_code) districts_blocks_gp_villages.block_code,
            districts_blocks_gp_villages.gram_panchayat_code,
            districts_blocks_gp_villages.village_code,
            districts_blocks_gp_villages.block_name,
            districts_blocks_gp_villages.gram_panchayat_name,
            districts_blocks_gp_villages.village_name
           FROM districts_blocks_gp_villages) dbg ON cr.block_code = dbg.block_code AND cr.gram_panchayat_code = dbg.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbg.village_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_body_types ulbt ON cr.urban_local_body_type_code = ulbt.localbody_type_code
     LEFT JOIN urban_local_bodies ulb ON cr.urban_local_body_code = ulb.localbody_code
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (urban_local_bodies_wards.ward_code) urban_local_bodies_wards.ward_code,
            urban_local_bodies_wards.ward_name
           FROM urban_local_bodies_wards) ulbw ON cr.locality_ward_code = ulbw.ward_code
     LEFT JOIN designations des ON cr.designation = des.id
     LEFT JOIN water_body_types wbt ON
        CASE
            WHEN cr.cleaned_wbt ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text AND cr.cleaned_wbt::numeric <= 2147483647::numeric THEN cr.cleaned_wbt::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END = wbt.id
     LEFT JOIN cooperative_society_banks csb ON
        CASE
            WHEN cr.cleaned_bank ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text AND cr.cleaned_bank::numeric <= 2147483647::numeric THEN cr.cleaned_bank::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END = csb.id
     LEFT JOIN audit_categories ac ON cr.category_audit = ac.id
     LEFT JOIN society_types st ON cr.cooperative_society_type_id = st.id
  ORDER BY cr.id
WITH DATA;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.chatbot_member_details
TABLESPACE pg_default
AS SELECT md.id,
    md.cooperative_registrations_id,
    md.m_general AS male_general,
    md.m_sc AS male_sc,
    md.m_st AS male_st,
    md.m_obc AS male_obc,
    md.f_general AS female_general,
    md.f_sc AS female_sc,
    md.f_st AS female_st,
    md.f_obc AS female_obc,
    md.t_general AS transgender_general,
    md.t_sc AS transgender_sc,
    md.t_st AS transgender_st,
    md.t_obc AS transgender_obc,
    md.ncd_id,
    md.created_at,
    md.updated_at,
    md.approval_status,
    md.status_code,
    COALESCE(s.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS state_name,
    COALESCE(dt.name, 'N/A'::character varying) AS district_name,
    COALESCE(md.m_general, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.m_sc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.m_st, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.m_obc, 0::bigint) AS total_male,
    COALESCE(md.f_general, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_sc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_st, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_obc, 0::bigint) AS total_female,
    COALESCE(md.t_general, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_sc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_st, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_obc, 0::bigint) AS total_transgender,
    COALESCE(md.m_general, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.m_sc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.m_st, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.m_obc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_general, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_sc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_st, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.f_obc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_general, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_sc, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_st, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(md.t_obc, 0::bigint) AS total_members
   FROM members_details md
     LEFT JOIN states s ON md.st_code = s.state_code
     LEFT JOIN districts dt ON md.dist_code = dt.district_code
WITH DATA;

-- View indexes:
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_member_details_approval_status ON public.chatbot_member_details USING btree (approval_status);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_member_details_cooperative_reg_id ON public.chatbot_member_details USING btree (cooperative_registrations_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_chatbot_member_details_id ON public.chatbot_member_details USING btree (id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_member_details_ncd_id ON public.chatbot_member_details USING btree (ncd_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chatbot_member_details_status_code ON public.chatbot_member_details USING btree (status_code);
description: The materialized view chatbot_member_details provides a structured and enriched dataset of cooperative membership demographics where each row represents member statistics linked to a cooperative via `cooperative_registrations_id`, capturing detailed category-wise counts segmented by gender and social groups including `male_general`, `male_sc`, `male_st`, `male_obc`, `female_general`, `female_sc`, `female_st`, `female_obc`, `transgender_general`, `transgender_sc`, `transgender_st`, and `transgender_obc`; it also includes geographic context through `state_name` and `district_name`; the view computes aggregated totals such as `total_male`, `total_female`, `total_transgender`, and overall `total_members` using null-safe calculations to ensure accuracy; additional metadata fields like `id`, `ncd_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `approval_status`, and `status_code` provide identification and record lifecycle context; the view is optimized with indexes to support efficient querying by cooperative identifiers, approval status, record status, and unique IDs—this view is designed for analytical querying and LLM usage where the model needs to understand population distribution, perform demographic analysis, and generate insights based on gender-wise and category-wise membership composition within cooperative entities.
